description.describe_ch: 本實作課程將引導學生實際體驗與實作企業真實專題/專案，藉由合作企業提供真實題目，學生將嘗試整合過往所學習的跨領域知識、AI工具與技術，以及創新與專案管理的應用能力，以提出合理的問題解決方案。並於過程中持續自我學習與自我檢討改進，以達到實戰能力的初步養成。
description.describe_eh: This course will guide students to actually experience and implement real topics from companies. By this, students will try to integrate the cross-domain knowledge, AI tools and technologies they have learned in the past, as well as the application of innovation and project management Ability to propose reasonable solutions to problems. And in the process, continue to self-learn and self-review and improve in order to achieve the initial development of actual combat ability.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
It is important that students are respectful towards instructors and fellow classmates, and that their behaviors not interfere with nor disrupt class activities. Therefore, students are expected to adhere to the following rules when attending the I classes:
1. Innovation Project is a team-based course. A lot of the work in this course will involve team effort. Each team member is required to contribute to his/her team. Class attendance and punctuality are of paramount importance to your team and your project work. All students are expected to be present in every class. Absence, late arrival and early dismissal are described below:
 Absence: Missing class for more than 20 minutes in one period
 Late Arrival: Arrive class more than 5 minutes late but not longer than 20 minutes in one period. (Note: For more than 20 minutes late, it will be considered as “absence”.)
 Early Dismissal: Leave class more than 5 minutes before the class is dismissed but not more than 20 minutes in one period. (Note: For more than 20 minutes earlier, it will be considered as “absence”.)
Rules for absence, late arrival and early dismissal are described below:
Rules for Absence
A maximum of nine (9) periods of missing classes (absence) with approval from the instructor is allowed per semester without penalty. Accepted reasons for absence include sickness/injury, obligatory personal reasons (such as attending the funeral of a close family member, pre-arranged medical appointment, etc.), official reason (such as representing university/school in a public event, seminar or competition). For students with over nine (9) periods of missing class, one (1) point will be deducted from the final score for each additional period of missing class (absence).
Rules for Late Arrival & Early Dismissal
Points will be deducted from the final score for students with 6 or more “late arrival’s” and/or “early dismissal’s” in a semester. Penalty for late arrival or early dismissal is as follows:
 With six to ten (6 – 10) “late arrival’s” and/or “early dismissal’s”, two (2) points will be deducted.
 With eleven to fifteen (11-15) “late arrival’s” and/or “early dismissal’s”, four (4) points will be deducted.
 With more than fifteen (15) “late arrival’s” and/or “early dismissal’s”, six (6) points will be deducted.
2
2. All cell phones, smartphones, and other electronic devices (e.g., pagers, iPods) must be turned off and hidden from view during class time.
3. There is NO use of electronic devices such as cell phones, iPads, smartphones, etc. allowed during exams and other graded in-class assignments. However, some exams or in-class assignments in this course may require the use of computers. Please follow the instructions specified by the instructor for those exams or in-class assignments.
4. Laptop and tablet computers are allowed for (quiet) note taking, class-related activities only: i.e., other activities such as checking personal e-mail or browsing the Internet that are not related to class tasks are prohibited. Please note all internet activities using FCU WiFi network are under the monitoring of FCU Office of Information Technology.
5. Food and beverages are NOT permitted in classrooms. Those must be consumed in designated areas only.
6. Students are responsible for what transpired if they miss a class. It is the student’s responsibility to contact a classmate to determine what was missed.
7. Talking and other disruptive behaviors are not permitted while classes are in session.
8. Be polite and respectful towards others, instructor and other students.
9. It is the student’s responsibility to notify the instructor of record in advance of a need for accommodation of a disability that has been verified by the University.
10. Students should address faculty as "Professor" or "Dr."
11. Students are expected to be professional and respectful of other students, instructors, ISCHOOL administration, and staff. That includes verbal and physical behavior as well as language used in email and phone messages.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: 請同學多研討相關實務應用，如有不懂之處，可以隨時與老師討論。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1.學生需要學習基本的資訊素養
2.學生必須知道如何篩選可靠的信息來源
3.學生需要學習如何使用正確的引用方法和格式
4.學生可以嘗試使用ChatGPT作為學習上的工具，但不包含直接抄襲
1.Students must learn basic information literacy skills
2.Students must know how to sift through trusted sources of information
3.Students need to learn how to use proper citation method and format
4.Students can try to use ChatGPT as a learning tool, but does not include direct plagiarism
